newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso ends off,other contracts slip.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso ends off,other contracts slip.

text.p: The same-day peso closed softer on Friday, heading lower along with other contracts on dealers buying dollars ahead of next week's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

"Foreign investors began to set positions in dollars," said one trader. "The pretext for all this is the Fed meeting next week...dollar buying snowballed and then local banks had to join in to cover themselves."
"It was here, though, that speculators hit the market to make a quick profit," another trader said.

The same-day peso closed 4.6 centavos weaker at 7.5350/7.5380 per dollar. Part of the adjustment was due to same-day contracts, which close early, catching up with other contracts which had weakened in late trade on Thursday.

The benchmark 48-hour peso was meanwhile 2.5 centavos weaker at 7.5520/7.5550, and its 24-hour counterpart 2.9 centavos weaker at 7.5450/7.5480 per dollar. Both contracts were narrowly mixed at the opening.
